provider_spend.notes: Measured as account usage deltas around the run; other concurrent use of the same accounts is included, Apify usage can lag, and SerpApi reports searches, not USD (priced only with --serpapi-usd-per-search). The runner does not enforce provider caps inside the tree under test.

honesty_notes: Model cost is the maximum cumulative total_cost_usd per session; token totals sum per-call usage of every result event (verify against modelUsage if exact token counts matter).
